name: 92596 · Winchester, CA
findings: ZIP 92596 (Winchester) has 51 nonprofit organizations. 16 of them (31%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 10 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 92596 (Winchester) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 92596 (Winchester) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 32% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 16 organizations here; 28% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
